root_causes.fact: The V1 recognizer required doubled literal backslashes while the frozen upstream build_description emits the visible text '\\n\\n' with one literal backslash before each n.

The frozen BulletListChecker is line anchored (^\\s*\\*...), so an opening quotation mark directly before the first '*' hides that bullet. Moving the opening quote to its own line preserves QuotationChecker and restores bullet visibility.

The candidate generator hard-coded 'note' after the required postscript marker; a visible forbidden-word constraint can reject every candidate. The repair uses the existing forbidden-safe token generator for free postscript payload text.

promotion_gate.required: A fresh independent run over the exact 200-row removed predecessor must report eligible_rows=193, compile_fail_rows=0, generation_fail_rows=0, checker_fail_rows=0, solved_rows=193 before this repair can receive clean historical composition credit.
